'''Ryan Obman Visage of Hell''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Ryan Obman]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15611">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15611 Visage of Hell], DeckTech (Ryan "SW only" Obman, 27 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15611/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15611/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Obman]]
* '''Published:''' 27 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Visage of Hell''
